---
applyTo: "**"
---

- Only implement features or fix tasks **when explicitly requested**.
- Do **not** create additional documentation files (`.md`, `.txt`, etc.) unless explicitly instructed.
- Do **not** create test systems. Always focus on the actual feature or fix.
- Do **not** run the server after minor changes. Only run it after the final implementation is complete—and ask before starting it.
- Always use `netlify dev` to start the server.
- Always use **PowerShell syntax** for all command-line instructions.
- After the final implementation, delete any temporary or residual files.
- When implementing a new frontend feature, always refer to the UI style guides and components defined in:
  - `/assets/style/main.css`
  - `/account/css/styles.css`
  - `/account/css/redesigned-styles.css`
  - if a style is not defined and there is need to make a new one then take refrence and make one that closely matches the existing design system.
